title: 12 Best Art Galleries in Amman
description: Explore Amman's vibrant art scene with our expert-curated list of the 12 best art galleries for 2026. Discover contemporary art, historical collections, and hidden gems.

places.name: Darat al Funun - The Khalid Shoman Foundation
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the permanent collection of contemporary Arab art and don't miss the outdoor sculptures integrated with ancient ruins.

places.name: The Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on the impressive range of works by pioneering Jordanian artists and the rotating international exhibitions.

places.name: Nabad Art Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for pieces by notable Jordanian artists like Hilda Hiary or Muhammad Musa. Their exhibitions change frequently, offering fresh perspectives.

places.name: Wadi Finan Art Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the range of contemporary sculpture and large-format paintings, often with vibrant colors and abstract themes.

places.name: Orient Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seek out works by well-known regional masters and rising stars in their frequently changing exhibitions.

places.name: Jacaranda Images
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for limited edition prints and captivating photography that captures Jordanian life and landscapes.

places.name: Fann A Porter
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for vibrant, often abstract or conceptual pieces that push artistic boundaries.

places.name: Darat King Abdullah II Fund for Development (KAFD)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Discover the fresh perspectives and experimental approaches of the next generation of Jordanian artists.

places.name: MMAG Foundation
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Engage with their thought-provoking, often conceptual exhibitions that delve into deeper socio-political or artistic themes.

places.name: Makan Art Space
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for unique, often site-specific installations and projects that challenge traditional gallery formats.

places.name: Foresight32 Art Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the variety of contemporary styles and themes, often reflecting regional narratives and artistic innovations.

places.name: Galerie Orfali
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Admire works by established Arab masters and explore the more traditional artistic expressions.
